reviews.author: Rose Mary Alexander
reviews.text: I like Buster's garage. Eric Newsome knows his stuff. If you need a good mechanic Go to Buster's garage.

reviews.author: Anthony Billitteri
reviews.text: Eric helped me out today when my brake caliper fell off my truck while traveling back home with 4 kids. He stopped what he was doing and came within 15 minutes and fixed it in a parking lot. Forever grateful for his help with a smile the whole time!

reviews.author: Darin Gonzalez
reviews.text: No matter which part of the United States you’re from. If you end up in South Carolina with vehicle issues of any kind Buster’s Garage is the place to go without a doubt. Eric is a genuine good hearted soul who will handle all of issues fast and efficiently! No matter how big the problem is Eric is the man!

reviews.author: Shirletha Wells
reviews.text: Didn’t even get my car serviced here. Called the gentleman to get a quote on the vehicle to fix the ac compressor and belt. He proceeds to say I have to look it up and gets quiet. He does express that my parts would cost $700. I then informed him that I already have my parts, I would just need labor. He then tells me he can’t do it and hangs up the phone in my face. Southern hospitality.

reviews.author: ILLY
reviews.text: Maybe He's a good mechanic and good guy, but wasn't very helpful on what I needed and he's even a stutterer, so I didn't understand a word that came out of his mouth, and it seems that I was bothering him! I don't know if I would come back again

reviews.author: Kiarra Stephenson
reviews.text: Very reasonable and efficient. Had no issues with getting the tow I needed. Customer service was friendly and dispatch time was fast. They did not have me waiting an extended period of time for service. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Kiara Laquisha17
reviews.text: Had my car done 2 days before christmas aleays my number 1 shop!! Yes they cost but they got the job done
